local Inventory = {}

function Inventory.add(items, name, count)
  items[name] = (items[name] or 0) + count
end

function Inventory.total(items)
  local sum = 0
  for _, count in pairs(items) do
    sum = sum + count
  end
  return sum
end

return Inventory
